Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply of 6.0 Tonnes of Carbon steel plate conforming to IS 2062, Grade E250 or equivalent grade in mentioned size as per Technical specification s annexure attached. a) Plates shall be Pre cut in dimension of 1000x1000mmx25mm - 20 nos b) Plates shall be Pre cut in dimension of 920x920mmx25mm - 08 nos c) Plates shall be Pre cut in dimension of 800x800mmx25mm - 06 nos 2. Test Certificate Requirement: a) The vendor shall submit the Manufacturer's Test Certificate (MTC/T C) for all supplied plates, traceable to the heat number marked on the respective plate. b) The heat number on the plate shall correspond to the heat number mentioned in the Test Certificate. c) If the Manufacturer's Test Certificate is not available, the vendor sh all submit a chemical and mechanical test certificate issued by an NAB-accredited laboratory for the supplied material, establishing c ompliance with IS 2062 Grade E250 or equivalent. Note: Test certificates shall be submitted along with the supply for acc eptance of the material. 3.
